title: Two re-runs of one run, the second priced after the first, accepted in either order and at once
assertion: Whichever acceptance commits first, the month ends on the second re-run. Accepting the first after the second is refused as `superseded`. Accepting the second after the first succeeds, and its page lists the changes against the first. Of two acceptances made at once, the first re-run's is refused as `superseded` whatever the timestamps. The second re-run's, when its transaction began before the other acceptance's, is refused as `changed_meanwhile`, and made again it succeeds. An accepted re-run is the run in effect for its period, and nothing deadlocks
noFileReason: No file of its own: SYNTHETIC 835s the pricing world already loads.
